name: Belph
source:
Elcia's operator and childhood friend - the man may look like a gentleman, but he's definitely not one. Watching people suffer is one of his favorite pastimes.

Belph will help you throughout the game by giving you his advice. He can be found in the Future.

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/area_x_cast_belph.html]official site[/url]]
